goal:
T57 — retire stale Critic tests in evolution runs (fixes the cost blow-up seen in production run job_b9fbd6da2e3f:
an R1 Critic test that the R2 redesign legitimately breaks failed on every attempt of R2-R5, so every round burnt all 3
attempts although the held-out suite passed from attempt 1; EvoForge cost 204c vs 52c).
In services/api/evoforge/evolution_rounds.py (T51/T53 critic mode, EvoForge lane):
- Track, per applied attempt, which accumulated Critic tests failed, split into earlier-round tests (from
  critic_history) and this round's new Critic tests.
- If two consecutive applied attempts fail exactly the same non-empty set of EARLIER-round Critic tests while ALL of this
  round's new Critic tests pass on both, treat those earlier tests as stale: remove them from the lane's critic_history
  for the rest of the run, stop retrying, and judge the latest attempt with the held-out suite as usual.
- Snapshot field "critic_retired": number of tests retired in this round (0 otherwise); emit a role "critic" event
  "retired N stale Critic tests (contradicted by this round's requirements)". critic_tests keeps meaning the suite size
  used this round.
- A real regression (an earlier test fails, then passes after a retry) must still be retried exactly as before (T53).
- No held-out signal enters feedback; scoring, statuses, manifest, previews and the single lane are unchanged.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t57.py.
